scenicChapters.title: Torquay surf coast → Lorne food stop
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 53 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

melbourne-great-ocean-road-and-otway-rai.storyWas: Ocean cliffs, rain forest shade and a proper three-day mood.

appalachians-snake-and-back-of-the-drago.title: Appalachians · Snake and Back of the Dragon
appalachians-snake-and-back-of-the-drago.slogan: A 430 km loop out of Shady Valley
appalachians-snake-and-back-of-the-drago.story: Remote bends and a better reason to cross state lines. A one-way ride of 430 km, Mountain City to Mountain City - roughly 8 h 16 in the saddle. On the way it passes Tazewell, Back of the Dragon and back through Tazewell. The climb of the day is The Snake US 421. It tops out at about 850 m. It is a high-mountain day.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: For 5 km this is Furka Pass, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2106 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

gotthard-tremola.story: From Airolo it runs 27 km to Andermatt; allow about 28 min of riding. The stops in between: Tremola lower hairpins, Tremola upper hairpins and Gotthard Pass. The highest point is about 2,300 m. Gotthard Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: For 25 km this is Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 25 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
